identity.title: [v0.92][podcast][51.a] Finalize show identity, artwork, rights, metadata, and mailbox readiness

values.summary: Execute the smallest proving validation DAG.

lanes.proof_role: Prove exact schema IDs, versions, field types and record paths; every declared provenance value, repository path and full Git commit; exact distribution and retained-source artwork bytes and metadata; complete #261/#342/#262 allocation equality; digest-linked title research; truthful pending gates; and every actual BASE...HEAD, staged, unstaged and untracked path against the declared allowlist.

Reject unknown fields, invalid pending nullability, unbounded or invalid scalar grammar, non-classified retained authority text, prohibited values, credentials, private mailbox content, codes and private-key material across exact JSON and bounded Markdown.

Fail closed unless the digest-bound structured title decision approves the exact title, concrete classified rights evidence and mailbox control/receive/provider/retention evidence agree, and every decision/evidence timestamp matches exact RFC3339 full-date T full-time UTC Z grammar in valid chronology; status changes alone cannot pass.
lanes.defer_reason: Deferred and expected to fail while operator title, rights confirmation, or mailbox control/receive evidence remains pending; publication is prohibited until this exact lane passes.

lanes.proof_role: Prove patch hygiene after the validator independently proves the complete actual path set against the immutable current-main preparation base.

values.failure_policy: Fail closed on unapproved identity pending mailbox proof missing rights provenance metadata or digest mismatch non-RGB/non-square artwork secret leakage path collision scope drift review finding CI failure or terminal mismatch.
